Dear Miss Yonge,
Don’t you think that an Index and some chronological tables would be of similar use to the [Cameos](/book/73)?

If you agree with [me](/person/939) I can get them done.

The printer is making a table of contents of which you shall see a proof.
I enclose a letter about the terrible story(?).

But I think the [Little Duke](/book/20) has been close and [rest of paragraph indecipherable]
I hope you like the gilt-edged copy of the [Pupils](/book/72).

Yours very faithfully
A.

Macmillan


[^1]: Although dated earlier than the previous letter from Macmillan, this letter is placed after it in the Macmillan letter book
